column1: # XR33 transcription (unchanged values) of Table 1 of Auger, Treu, Bolton, Gavazzi, Koopmans, Marshall, Moustakas & Burles 2010,
#   ApJ 724, 511 ("The Sloan Lens ACS Survey. X. Stellar, dynamical, and total mass correlations of massive early-type galaxies"),
#   read from the arXiv source arXiv:1007.2880 (file T_lens_data.tex), retrieved 2026-09-27.
# Columns: name; re_V_kpc = effective radius corrected to rest-frame V (5500 A), kpc (Om = 0.3, OL = 0.7, h = 0.7);
#   sig_e2, e_sig_e2 = velocity dispersion within R_e/2 (km/s, Jorgensen-corrected from sigma_SDSS);
#   logMs_chab, e, logMs_salp, e = total stellar mass (SPS; Auger et al. 2009); logM_e2, e = total projected mass within R_e/2
#   from the power-law lensing + dynamics model; fDM_chab, e, fDM_salp, e = projected dark fraction within R_e/2;
#   gamma_p, e = power-law density slope; outlier = 1 for the six hyper-plane outliers (dagger in the table; excluded by
#   Auger et al. 2010 ApJ 721 L163 from their 53-lens IMF analysis).
